name: MInDS-14 English-US intent classification

dataset_metadata.source_split: en-US/train (all 563 examples; no official held-out split)

question_instruction: Which one intent best describes the customer's banking request?

options.abroad: banking or card use while abroad
options.address: change or update a mailing address
options.app_error: a technical problem with the banking app
options.atm_limit: ATM cash withdrawal or a withdrawal limit
options.business_loan: a business loan or business financing
options.card_issues: a problem with a bank card
options.direct_debit: a direct debit or scheduled payment
options.freeze: freeze or unfreeze a card or account
options.high_value_payment: a large or high-value payment or transfer
options.joint_account: open or manage a joint account
